title: GOAL: agents use stored API tokens through one audited wrapper, values never printed (human 2026-10-05)
spec: Human 2026-10-05: agents need access to stored tokens (first: elevenlabs-api-key for TheSearch) to adapt. guardrails.sh blocks ~/.config/f and the Keychain as a hard floor; protected-paths.txt is edit-by-hand. luna-inbox scripts/with-secrets.sh already shows the safe pattern: a reviewed script sources f.sh internally and exports values into one child process only. Generalise it in the orchestrator, gated by a human-owned allowlist.
